notes.finding: Five feature bodies open on a subjectless verb fragment: "Lets each cook pick", "Asks each cook whether", "Asks each cook to name", "Adds a judges section", "Emails every cook".

Step 01 says "The smaller number is your entry cap" (outlets vs tables), while Tab 2 runs 19 entries on 12 outlets; the insulated-pot exception covers it but the advice reads stricter than the example.

"about three judges per 12 entries so nobody tastes past their limit" only reduces load if judges split the field; FAQ 5 caps a judge at 15 pots while Tabs 3 and 4 have 16 and 18 entries. Recommendation, unsourced.
